newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Tunasmas to acquire 50 pct stake in Niaga.
newsitem.headline: Tunasmas to acquire 50 pct stake in Niaga.

text.p: Indonesian brokerage firm PT Lippo Securities said on Monday privately-owned PT Tunasmas Paduarta planned to acquire a 50 percent stake in Bank Niaga.

Lippo Securities said in a statement Tunasmas had agreed with two of the bank's major shareholders, PT Austindo Teguhjaya and PT Austindo Nusantara Jaya, to buy 75.64 million shares, or around a 40-percent stake in the bank, at 8,000 rupiah per share.
Lippo said Tunasmas planned to buy 18.9 million shares, or a 10-percent stake, from the public at the same price.
Lippo said it was acting as an underwriter for the tender offer and that Tunasmas had sufficient funds to complete the purchase.
